title: Build the delegation extension: launch, binding, inheritance and cleanup
statement: Implement child launch with `--mode json -p --no-session`, shell disabled and stdin closed; private restricted-permission prompt files; task-scoped context; exact model inheritance; the intersected tool allowlist; bounded timeout with abort propagated to the process tree; and deletion of temporary material on every exit path. Register `kiln_delegate` over that runtime, in the same task, because a registration cannot wrap an implementation that does not exist yet.
notes:
Scope settled 2026-09-19, before implementation.

THE TASK-BINDING OBSERVER (D42). `taskBindingObserved` is produced by a private Kiln observer extension loaded explicitly into the child. Its `before_provider_request` hook inspects the FINAL provider payload for a framed task carrying a one-time nonce, a length and a digest, and emits only a minimal attestation - never the payload - over a dedicated extra pipe the parent opens. The parent validates that attestation against the nonce, length and digest it generated. A mismatch in any of the three produces no binding.

REJECTED SOURCES, AND WHY. Model output and ordinary JSON events are not acceptable: both are things the child says about itself, which is the failure REQ-0026 exists to prevent. Writing or hashing the prompt file is not acceptable either: it proves the parent PREPARED the task, not that the child CONSUMED it. The provider payload at the last moment before dispatch is the first point where consumption is observable, and the hook runs inside the child but reports on the child's outbound request rather than on its own account of itself.

WHAT THE ATTESTATION MAY CARRY. The nonce, the length and the digest, and nothing else. Never the task text, never a credential or a credential-derived value, never an absolute path. The payload is neither retained nor returned.

THE TSK-0054 BOUNDARY (D43). This task builds the runtime and registers `kiln_delegate`, and it must pass every run through the EXISTING `verifyChild` gate before any substantive output is exposed. There is no temporarily permissive delegation path. Expanding and proving the complete refusal matrix - malformed events, nonzero exit, provider mismatch, out-of-role writes - is TSK-0054's, under ACC-0075. In short: this task produces the run record and gates on it; TSK-0054 judges the full set of ways a record can be bad.

PROCESS TEARDOWN (D44). The runtime reuses `trackDescendants` and `stopTree` from `lib/supervisor.mjs` and owns one child tree wrapping those primitives. No second PID-only termination implementation, and no change to supervisor behaviour unless an unavailable seam forces a separate decision, which would be recorded before it is made. F116's rule stands: a pid alone is not an identity.

WATCH ITEM. F130 - `A8 each companion is a separate process` - is a watch item, not a blocker. It has passed in every cell of the last four CI runs. This task spawns child processes under a bounded timeout, so the areas overlap; if it recurs during this task the run stops and is reported rather than absorbed.
